purpose: Execute a leakage-controlled, laboratory-anchor-held-out, nested and measurement-batch-clustered analysis on the seven-accession intersection frozen by T249 from four public paper/data source lineages.

target_universe.membership_dependency: The T249 intersection uses finite-positive availability in all four source lineages before T250. Every outer fold is therefore conditional on the held-out source contributing indirectly to the frozen target universe; T250 does not re-estimate membership after the split.
target_universe.availability_rule: A common target contributes only when the audited source map records a finite strictly positive author value; blank, explicit zero and NA states remain missing.

outer_split.held_out_source_membership_note: false means no post-freeze T250 recomputation; the held-out source remains an indirect dependency through the pre-frozen T249 all-source intersection.

models.constant: development-target mean; Spearman is undefined by contract
models.full: unpenalized-intercept ridge on the release-fixed sequence feature table
models.composition_only: unpenalized-intercept ridge on amino-acid composition features only
models.standardization: development-partition mean and standard deviation; zero standard deviation replaced by 1.0

uncertainty.cluster: held-out measurement batch; no donor independence is inferred from laboratory count
uncertainty.low_cluster_count_policy: Report measurement-batch count and avoid donor-level effective-n claims.

negative_control.alpha_policy: hold the observed nested-selected full-model alpha fixed within each outer fold
negative_control.interpretation: A permutation null conditional on the observed nested-selected alpha; it is not a fully selection-aware null that re-runs alpha selection for every permutation.

estimand_boundary: The primary score is the equal-weight mean of source-local measurement-batch Spearman values. Report row count (783), measurement-batch clusters (115), source/laboratory anchors (4) and unresolved donor-level effective n separately.
claim_boundary: This is an exploratory four-source strict-common-target portability analysis conditioned on the all-source target-availability intersection. It improves paper-data source compatibility and executes real models, but it does not establish four independent biological cohorts, donor-level generalization, a fully selection-aware permutation null, evaluator lockbox performance, no-author reproduction, external adoption or scientific submission readiness.
